mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 100k signals increased household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 600k signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where HOUST < 600k for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 1% growth signals reduced manufacturing activity, which depresses earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO < 1% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month period where the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, raising discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the unemployment rate below 6% signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE < 6% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures below $340B signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS < 340B for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 100k combined with a federal funds rate below 2% signals a supportive labor and monetary environment, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 100k for 2 months AND FEDFUNDS < 2% for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS growth > 100k and FEDFUNDS < 2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).
